unsupported: 3000 taxes on payroll and workforce: work-permit fees for foreign workers (Ministry of Labour; amounts by decree and budget laws, not read); no payroll tax in the laws read (DL 144/1959, Social Security Code). notLevied.why: 4200: no net wealth tax: Constitution of Lebanon (1926, as amended 2004) art. 81: no tax can be established or levied except by a comprehensive law applied to all the Lebanese territory; art. 82: no tax may be amended or eliminated except by a law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Lebanon_2004.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Decree-Law 144/1959 (income tax), Decree-Law 146/1959 (inheritance and gifts), VAT Law 379/2001, Budget Laws 324/2024 and Decree 56/2025. convention R5-3k-G (extended in pass 3l to states without a closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3l).
